ghi_chu: Danh sách ảnh của video. Sinh bởi hand-written; tao_anh.py đọc file này.

nhan_dang.ong-son: Character identity (Ông Sơn, a friendly Vietnamese shop owner): around 50 years old, slightly plump, round warm face with a small smile, short black hair with a little gray at the temples, thick eyebrows; wearing a light sky-blue short-sleeve button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a bright orange half apron tied at the waist, dark gray trousers and brown shoes.
nhan_dang.co-lan: Character identity (Cô Lan, the cashier): a Vietnamese woman around 28, long black hair tied in a ponytail, gentle oval face, bright eyes; wearing a mustard-yellow short-sleeve blouse, black trousers and flat shoes.
nhan_dang.anh-tam: Character identity (Anh Tâm, the stock clerk): a lean energetic Vietnamese man around 25, short black hair under an orange baseball cap, wearing a dark gray t-shirt, blue jeans and sneakers.
nhan_dang.chi-hanh: Character identity (Chị Hạnh, the head accountant): a Vietnamese woman around 35, black hair in a neat bun, round glasses, calm serious face; wearing a light lavender cardigan over a cream blouse and a dark skirt.
nhan_dang.tro-ly-an: Character identity (Anh An, accountant assistant): a young Vietnamese man around 24, short neat black hair, no glasses; wearing a navy-blue shirt with the sleeves rolled up and dark trousers.
nhan_dang.tro-ly-mai: Character identity (Chị Mai, accountant assistant): a young Vietnamese woman around 23, short bob haircut; wearing a pastel pink blouse and a gray skirt.
nhan_dang.anh-hung: Character identity (Anh Hùng, the overworked all-in-one employee): a tired-looking Vietnamese man around 30, messy short black hair, dark circles under his eyes; wearing a slate blue-gray button shirt and beige trousers.
nhan_dang.binh: Character identity (Bình, the new employee): a shy young Vietnamese man around 22, neat short black hair; wearing a navy hoodie, gray trousers and a small backpack.
nhan_dang.ba-tu: Character identity (Bà Tư, a customer): an elderly Vietnamese woman around 62, gray hair in a low bun, kind wrinkled smile; wearing a light brown blouse and dark trousers, carrying a cloth shopping bag.
nhan_dang.thanh-nien: Character identity (a young customer): a Vietnamese man around 20, short hair, headphones around his neck; wearing a gray jacket, black t-shirt and jeans.
nhan_dang.ten-trom: Character identity (Tên trộm, a sneaky thief in a family-friendly cartoon): a slim adult Vietnamese man; a black knitted beanie pulled low and a dark charcoal scarf-mask covering his nose and mouth so only his narrowed, mischievous brown eyes and thick eyebrows show; a dark navy long-sleeve hoodie, charcoal gray trousers, black gloves and dark sneakers. Playful rather than scary.
